name: qqpet-server
description: Standalone authority server for QQPet shared pet data

scripts.start: npm run build --silent && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/server/src/index.js start
scripts.init: npm run build --silent && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/server/src/index.js init
scripts.pair: npm run build --silent && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/server/src/index.js pair
scripts.backup: npm run build --silent && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/server/src/index.js backup
scripts.revoke-device: npm run build --silent && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/server/src/index.js revoke-device
scripts.ctl: npm run build --silent && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning dist/server/src/index.js ctl
